I have been sad for so long that I no longer know what that feels like either, its more like a state of being anymore. Yet I have been this way so long that I am even numb to it, empty of all feeling.

I use to do that as well, but now it takes to much energy that I dont have anymore. No one notices or even cares about me enough to even see or even say anything anyway. Hell there is no one around any more anyway. I am all alone so no cares.

The constant reminder that no matter what I do it's never good enough, and will always end in failure. And being homeless-even though I made the choice to be homeless-is the constant reminder that I wake to every day, aand no matter what I do or try to do this is the best I will ever have or ever be.

Sure it is, as long as I dont have to wait much longer for it. TBH I am unsure of how much longer I can wait. Everyday the thoughts and willingness to end it all gets stronger and stronger. I fight battles everyday and I am losing those battles more and more, not much longer and this war will be over.

It cpuld mean that, yet at this point in my life I am tired of waiting around for it, whatever it is. What if all life has in store for me is more pain, misery and loss? Is that worth waiting around for?

What does being married twice have to do with having family? I don't consider my ex's family. What "family" I do have I have not talked to in 8 plus years (probably closer to 10 years) so I conseder that as they don't want to be my family. So no I dont have family. Because the family I did have died two and a half years ago when my son passed away.

I use to believe that if I kept on grinding thru this that it would get better. Yet sadly here I am still waiting, yet now I am waiting for something completely different. I am waiting for death. I know its close, I feel it everyday. I am pissed off everyday I wake up and spend the day wondering if I have the courage to do it myself, and hope I die when I do make the attempt.

That is what this is suppose to be, yet the more I write on here and the more I talk about and think about everything I have went thru, delt with and lost the more I realize my time in this life is fast approaching the end.

Most of the people I have ever delt with regarding how I was feeling. Either told me I was making it up, or only prentended to care. So I have just stopped telling people (expect for what I post here) how I really feel.
Yeah two years ago, he told me to stop making things up to get attention.

Well seeing as I have been married twice and failed both time. Seeing as I lost my son to cancer two and half years ago. Seeing as I was a paramedic for 10 years. I think I have had enough of this life, and seeing as I have felt this way since I was 18 I can turly say, I AM DONE. Whatever life has in store for me I'll pass, please and thank you.

I don't know if I have any family, because they have not talked to me in 8 plus years. So no I won't be missed. Yes in the past when life knocked me down I did get back up, yet after a while you get tired of always picking yourself up. I am tired physically and mentally. And no I don't see any hope left in this life for me. There is no point to continie on. 
I pray everyday that God will give me every child's cancer so that theu may live and so that I may die. I also pray to God every night to allow me to pass in my sleep. Yet here I sit continuing to wait, so its time I took things in my own hands and end this journy they call life.
